The full original `ObjManifestVersion(originalManifest96, originalLimits)` result is independently accepted as `Result.ok` of the exact 32-byte version from the original ordinal 25 control. The actual Reflexivity proof retains production manifest admission, encoding and HashWire hashing. This is a specific finite equation, not general Hash conformance or Read33 acceptance.

Each phase supplied 15 inputs containing 11 source files. The official compiler selected and admitted **8 modules**. `Object`, `ObjectRead` and `ObjectStore` were supplied but not selected. Frozen preparation metadata still records the supplied closure; it is not an 11-module native acceptance claim.

The positive audit checked 85 artifact files, 40 build outputs, 8 oleans, 740 declarations with empty observed axioms, 25 successful processes and 8 kernel replays. All source, lock, tool, epoch, zero-memory-event, idle and storage postconditions passed. Timing covers the selected verification closure; no target-only timing, cache or efficiency claim is made.
